verdict.rationale: Viam documents official SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter. The SDKs automatically work with custom hardware modules, and the docs explicitly say an AI agent with an SDK can operate a machine. GitHub corroborates that multiple SDKs exist for building client applications against the open-source, gRPC-based RDK. Missing for 10: per-SDK reference depth (API coverage, versioning, package distribution) is not evidenced, and there is no independent hands-on report of building with the SDKs.
